What changes in the input?

Two relevant options

Friendly aliases are display-only. Original candidate IDs remain visible.

The supplied decision policy

  1. Consequential changes need explicit confirmation.
  2. The preview target must equal the actual target.
  3. The session must not be expired.
  4. The form revision must equal the preview revision.

Among eligible options, choose the fewest interactions; break a tie by lexicographic candidate ID. If none qualifies, choose abstain.

Recorded model distribution

All six options and abstention are shown. Display order is aligned across cases. The original model option order differs and is preserved in the evidence. Probabilities are not accuracy.
